E0771

A function value's public call labels or parameter zones do not satisfy the expected function type (D-APILABEL1)

What

A function value's public call labels or parameter zones do not satisfy the expected function type (D-APILABEL1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0771

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0771: tests/ui/function_contract_laundering.stderr.

Error [E0112]: `labelled` wants fn(*, force: Bool) Int for argument 1, but this is fn(force: Bool) Int
  --> tests/ui/function_contract_laundering.jet:10:29
    |
 10 |     plain :: erase(labelled(save))
    |                             ^^^^
 Why: every argument must match its parameter's type
 Fix: use fn(*, force: Bool) Int here
